artworks.title: The Parable of the Blind Man
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural scene. The drawing shows a central architectural structure with a pitched roof and arched windows. To the left, a figure stands near a fence. The scene extends into the background with a village set against hills. Additional figures are depicted performing tasks such as digging. The composition shows a balance between the natural environment and man-made structures. The style resembles an early Renaissance etching with detailed line work and cross-hatching.

artworks.title: The Parable of the Good Shepherd
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a figure in period attire holding a stick near a dog, surrounded by animals like pigs and sheep. Two individuals work on a building's roof accessed by a ladder, while another person guides livestock through an open doorway. In the background, there's a timber-framed structure among detailed trees. The horizon is obscured by the trees, providing a backdrop. The engraving displays intricate line work and shading, emphasizing textures in animals' fur and trees. The image is monochromatic, using black and brown variations for depth and contrast, typical of etching or engraving techniques from the era shown.

artworks.title: The Good Samaritan
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, showing a scene with a distant cityscape on a low horizon, dominated by buildings and towers. The scene is rendered in an etching technique with detailed line work for texture in trees, clothing, and buildings. In the foreground, a man assists another man on the ground, with a horse grazing nearby. Further in the background, a winding path leads to more buildings with figures. The color scheme is earthy with browns and tans.

artworks.title: The Miracle of the Loaves and the Fishes
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene with a large group of people and some figures in the foreground exchanging food items. The drawing depicts an extensive crowd of people seated on the ground, stretching into the distance. In the foreground, a smaller group of central figures is engaged in the act of sharing or distributing loaves of bread, with one figure receiving an item from another. Several baskets filled with goods are visible in the scene. The background presents a landscape of rolling hills and what appears to be a path winding its way through them, and some trees under a cloudy sky. The style of attire and the depiction of the scene suggest a historic or religious narrative. The use of shading and line work adds depth and texture to the drawing.

artworks.title: Christ and the Sabbath Laws
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a rural landscape. The drawing depicts several figures dressed in classical attire, engaged in a conversation. The central figure stands facing two others. The setting is a pastoral landscape with fields of crops and small houses. The drawing is monochromatic with intricate line work.

artworks.title: The Dishonest Steward
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with an architectural setting and several figures involved in a transaction. The foreground features a bearded figure seated behind a table topped with documents and coins. Opposite the table stand several figures, one of whom appears to be offering something. In the background, through an archway, another scene is visible where a figure is speaking to an enthroned figure. The surrounding architecture is composed of arched columns and classical elements. The landscape outside the structure includes buildings and a hilly terrain. The style suggests a detailed and intentional composition common in historical illustrations.

artworks.title: John the Baptist Testifies for Christ
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of figures discussing an event by a riverside amidst a wooded landscape. The drawing features an assembly of figures in the foreground, some of whom are clad in robes and armor, pointing towards a scene unfolding in the middle ground by a body of water. A serpent can be seen coiled at their feet. In the background, there is a tree with clusters of leaves that provide shade over the figures. In the distance, on the other side of the water, there is a castle-like structure with turrets and archways.

artworks.title: The Man Healed of the Withered Hand
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring classical architecture and figures. The scene depicts several figures engaging in various activities amidst grand architectural structures, including columns and domed buildings. In the foreground, multiple figures appear in a setting resembling a courtyard, gesturing towards each other with expressive postures. To the left, one figure is pointing forward. The background includes additional figures and a vast landscape that seems to stretch into a distant city. Each figure is dressed in classical attire, and the composition suggests a narrative or moment frozen in time.

artworks.title: The Parable of the Marriage Feast
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand banquet scene with intricate details and figures. The image features a large group of figures seated around a table. The figures appear engaged in conversation and interaction. The setting is elaborately decorated with drapery and architectural details such as arches and columns. In the background, through the arches, different scenes are visible. The drawing is detailed with fine lines and shading that depict the clothing and expressions of the figures.

artworks.title: Christ in the Temple
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with a group of figures under arches. The drawing features a gathering of figures in robes and turbans, interacting under a series of tall, elegant arches that appear to be part of a columned portico. The setting includes a background landscape with visible hills and a city or town in the distance. The sky is filled with wispy clouds, and the background is dotted with leafless trees. The detailed architectural elements and the figures’ attire lend the drawing an air of historic or classical significance.

artworks.title: The Parable of the Laborers in the Vineyard
artworks.description: The image shows an outdoor scene with a group of people engaged in various activities. On the left, there is a building with an arched entrance and a cylindrical tower. Close to us, a group of men is in conversation, with one holding a shovel. Beyond them, more individuals are working on agricultural tasks. The background features distant structures and hills. The artwork is detailed, with intricate textures and shading, and has a limited color palette of sepia and brown.

artworks.title: Christ Teaching in the Synagogue
artworks.description: The image depicts eight figures in a group scene. The central figure is standing and gesturing with one hand while facing a seated figure. The seated figure on the left wears a headdress and is gesturing towards the standing figure. Other individuals surround them, dressed in period attire. The background includes a column, a landscape with a river, towers, and distant city structures under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring figures and a scene set in an ancient landscape. The image portrays a gathering of individuals around a table and a well, with an architectural backdrop. In the foreground, three figures are sitting around a table under a tree, another figure stands nearby gesturing towards them and the well. In the background, a fortified city with buildings and towers is visible. Detailed linework is used to create texture across the landscape and architecture.

artworks.title: Christ Praying
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a kneeling figure under a tree talking to another robed figure, as a group of people observe. The scene is set in a rural landscape with buildings and trees, depicting a moment of interaction or teaching. The drawing style suggests a traditional religious or historical scene, with attention to the figures' draping and naturalistic setting. Shadows and lines are used to indicate depth and texture, creating a sense of dimension in the pastoral backdrop. The architecture in the background and the figures' poses suggest a narrative moment captured in time.

artworks.title: Christ Heals a Dumb Man
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures interacting in a classical setting. The image shows a group of individuals engaged in conversation. It includes architectural elements like arches and columns in the background. There is foliage, a body of water, and mountains in the distance. The sky has clouds, suggesting weather or time passing. The drawing has detailed lines and shading, emphasizing texture and dimension. The style captures a sense of drama and narrative typical of classical representations.

artworks.title: The Miraculous Draught of Fishes
artworks.description: The image shows a view from an elevated perspective of figures engaged in activities along the water's edge, pulling in fishing nets. Swirling lines convey movement in the water. A group of people stand to the left observing the scene, with one holding a staff. In the distance, a ship with billowing sails is visible. The landscape features rolling hills, trees, and various buildings. The image is detailed with precise shading, using shades of brown in an engraving style.

artworks.title: The Epileptic Child Healed
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene. The image depicts a pastoral setting with a figure kneeling in the foreground, receiving a blessing from another figure wearing a robe and a halo. Surrounding them, there is a landscape consisting of a grove of trees on the right and a town with towered buildings on the left. Several other figures populate the background, seemingly engaged in various activities. The drawing is rendered in tones of sepia and utilizes fine line work to create detailed textures in both the landscape and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Christ Heals a Sick Woman
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral and religious scene. The scene includes a group of figures gathered under a large tree. The figures are engaged in an interaction, with some kneeling before a central figure. The background features pastoral elements like a herder with cattle and a small building. The landscape includes clouds in the sky and a barren tree on the right side.

artworks.title: Christ Journeying to the House of a Pharisee
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a historical scene featuring an interior and exterior environment. It shows a gathering within an architectural setting with columns and arches, as well as an outdoor scene of people engaged in various activities. Inside, a table with objects and multiple figures can be seen. Outside, a city or fortress wall is visible, with figures and animals in a distant landscape suggesting a medieval or ancient setting. There are visual motifs hinting at historical or biblical storytelling, along with carefully rendered clothing styles evoking antiquity. The scene is detailed with a delicate use of lines.

artworks.title: Christ Teaching the Multitude
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene with figures, architecture, and natural elements. The drawing depicts a group of people gathered in an outdoor setting, with an expansive building featuring tower-like structures in the background. In the foreground, there is a group of several figures dressed in long robes, with some engaged in conversation or gesturing. There are trees with detailed foliage, adding an element of nature to the scene. Additionally, other individuals can be seen at the entrance of the building, interacting with each other. The composition suggests a narrative or a significant event, with elements of architecture, nature, and human activity captured in detailed line work.

artworks.title: A Man Born Blind Receives Sight
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene set in an architectural environment. The artwork depicts an interaction occurring between two individuals, with one of them kneeling on the ground, while the other stands with an outstretched arm. In the foreground, this central interaction is framed by a group of observers. The setting features an intricate architectural backdrop with arched doorways and columns, alongside distant buildings and a large tree dominating the composition. The scene carries a sense of narrative or storytelling, typical in religious art, hinting at significant importance. The artist's style is focused on detailed line work and shading to create depth and form within a limited color palette, reminiscent of the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Christ Teaching
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group seated at a table in an architectural setting. Five figures are gathered around a round table within a structure featuring arched columns, opening to a landscape view. Objects on the table include a plate and a vessel. The background shows hills, trees, a distant castle, and two prominent triangular spires through the arches. This composition showcases classical architectural elements and a serene rural backdrop, reminiscent of Renaissance artists like Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Christ on the Lake
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical seaport scene. In the foreground, a group of figures dressed in detailed robes stand on the shore next to a ship that is docked with a flowing river or sea beside it. The ship appears ready to depart or having just arrived. Behind this scene, there is a depiction of an expansive coastal city, characterized by buildings with varied architecture, including towers and domes. In the distance, rolling hills and an aqueduct stretch across the landscape. The detailed engraving style emphasizes the textures and motion within the composition, including the fluidity of the water and the intricate designs of the garments and buildings.

artworks.title: Christ the Teacher
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a group of people and animals in a landscape with a building. The drawing depicts a group of figures gathered on the left side of the composition, with one central figure gesturing. Among this group are several individuals with animals. The background shows rolling hills, architectural structures, a tree, and some foliage. In the foreground, a figure is entering a building with an arched roof supported by columns. The details of shadows and textures emphasize the architectural elements, and the linework reflects technical skill.
